statements.text: Sarah Brink enters her fourth season as the Head Women's Soccer Coach at Denison University in 2026.
Associate Vice President and Director of Athletics Nan Carney-DeBord announced on April 3, 2023, the hiring of Sarah Brink as the next Head Women’s Soccer Coach at Denison University.
